blockers.description: Reopen evidence: Railway production, read 2026-10-05 via the Railway API: every service (api, ai-worker, events-worker, ingestion-worker, notifications-worker) has `OTEL_ENABLED=false` and no `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT`; `ws` has no OTel vars. `infra/terraform/environments/production/terraform.tfvars` keeps OTel off until `otel_exporter_endpoint` is set, and it is not set. Production exports no traces, metrics or logs.

Reopen evidence: `artifacts/reports/correlation-test.csv` trace IDs are not valid W3C IDs (e.g. `a1b2c3d4e5f6g7h8...`, `abc123def456ghi789...` contain non-hex characters). They were hand-written, not observed.

Reopen evidence: `artifacts/reports/mttr-baseline.json` metadata says `measurement_method: Manual testing with simulated incidents`. KPI "MTTD <2min" cannot be measured with no production telemetry and no alert delivery.

To close: (1) Done when IFC-032 is done: production traces and logs correlate in the hosted backend, and an MTTD is measured from a real alert. Closing requires production evidence (configured endpoint, real trace ID, received alert); local, in-memory or template artifacts do not count.

notes: OpenTelemetry tracing configured with unified logs, metrics, and traces.

status_history.note: Reopened from Completed by the honest-status audit: the evidence fails the task's own criteria. See blockers.
